name: William Haile
bio: A Representative from Mississippi; born in 1797; moved to Mississippi and settled in Woodville, Wilkinson County; member of the State house of representatives in 1826; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Nineteenth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Christopher Rankin; reelected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twentieth Congress and served from July 10, 1826, to September 12, 1828, when he resigned; unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 1828 to the Twenty-first Congress; delegate to the State constitutional convention in 1832; died near Woodville, Miss., March 7, 1837.
